requirements.description: A registered user signs in with valid credentials and is redirected to the shop.
Invalid, retired or missing credentials are rejected with a clear error message.
Choosing the User role requires confirming a limited-access warning.
Form controls offer the expected options and protect sensitive input.
Sign-in is allowed only after the terms and conditions are accepted.

testCases.title: Admin signs in with valid credentials and lands on the shop

steps.action: Enter the valid username and password
Keep the Admin role and Student occupation selected
Accept the terms and conditions
Click Sign In
steps.expected: The button shows a progress state

testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to /angularpractice/shop and the 'Shop Name' heading is visible.

testCases.title: User role signs in after confirming the limited-access modal

steps.action: Enter the valid username and password
Select the User role
Click Okay on the modal
steps.expected: Modal closes and User is selected

steps.action: Select Consultant, accept the terms and click Sign In

testCases.title: Valid username with an invalid password is rejected

steps.action: Enter the valid username and an invalid password
Accept the terms and click Sign In

testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Incorrect username/password.' is shown and the user stays on the login page.

testCases.title: Unknown username with a valid password is rejected

steps.action: Enter an unregistered username and the valid password
Accept the terms and click Sign In

testCases.expectedResult: Error 'Incorrect username/password.' is shown and the user stays on the login page.

testCases.title: Empty username and password show a validation message

steps.action: Leave both fields empty and click Sign In

testCases.title: Retired password shows guidance to use the new password

steps.action: Enter the valid username with the retired password 'learning'
Accept the terms and click Sign In

testCases.expectedResult: Message explains the old password is no longer valid and shows the new password.

testCases.title: Cancelling the limited-access modal keeps the Admin role selected
preconditions: Login page is open with Admin selected by default

steps.action: Select the User role
Click Cancel

testCases.expectedResult: Modal closes and the Admin role remains selected.

testCases.title: Occupation dropdown offers Student, Teacher and Consultant

steps.action: Inspect the occupation dropdown options

testCases.expectedResult: Options are Student, Teacher and Consultant in that order, with Student selected by default.

testCases.title: Password field masks the entered characters

steps.action: Type a password into the password field

testCases.expectedResult: The password field is of type 'password' so characters are masked.

testCases.title: Sign In button shows a progress state while credentials are verified

steps.action: Enter any non-empty credentials
Click Sign In

testCases.expectedResult: Button returns to 'Sign In' once verification completes.

testCases.title: Sign-in is blocked until the terms and conditions are accepted

steps.action: Enter valid credentials
Leave the terms checkbox unticked and click Sign In

testCases.expectedResult: Sign-in is prevented and the user is asked to accept the terms.
testCases.notes: Exploration showed sign-in succeeds without accepting terms. Confirm the requirement with the product owner before automating.
